a:r.a:t: Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs) Can Distinguish Human Populations

p:cNvPr.descr: A complex schematic shows the levels of identification for a haplotype. (a) The schematic begins with the SNPs, labeled to the left and organized on a chart below. The chart is set up so that the viewer knows the chromosome number, the individual, the sequences, and the locations of the SNPs. The leftmost column is labeled chromosome A; below this are the labels Individual 1 (top), Individual 2 (middle) and Individual 3 (second from bottom), and Individual 4 (bottom). The sequences for each individual will be given and the highlighted SNP, all of which are labeled above, will be indicated with its color in parentheses after the SNP. For individual 1, its first sequence is AACAC(yellow)GCCA. For individual 2, its first sequence is AACAC(blue)GCCA. For individual 3, the first sequence is AACAT(green)GCCA. For individual 4, the first sequence is AACAC(purple)GCCA. To the right of each group of sequences, there are 3 dots indicating the number of thousands of base pairs (3). The next sequences are as follows. Individual 1: TTCGG(yellow)GGTC; Individual 2: TTCGA(blue)GGTC; Individual 3: TTCGG(green)GGTC; Individual 4: TTCGG(purple)GGTC. To the right there are 3 dots indicating the number of thousands of base pairs between the sequences. To the right is the final set of sequences, as follows. Individual 1: AGTCG(yellow)ACCG; Individual 2: AGTCA(blue)ACCG; Individual 3: AGTCA(green)ACCG; Individual 4: AGTCG(purple)ACCG. To the right there are 3 dots indicating the number of thousands of base pairs. (b) The next section of the schematic concerns haplotypes (labeled left). The leftmost column has the following rows labeled top to bottom: haplotype 1 (sequence shaded yellow), haplotype 2 (sequence shaded blue), haplotype 3 (sequence shaded green), and haplotype 4 (sequence shaded purple). The sequence for haplotype 1 is CTCAAAGTACGGTTCAGGCA. The whole sequence is shaded yellow. Below, the sequence for haplotype 2 is the following: TTGATTGCGCAACAGTAATA (all shaded blue). The sequence for haplotype 3 is: CCCGATCTGTGATACTGGTG (all shaded green). The sequence for haplotype 4 is: TCGATTCCGCGGTTCAGACA (all shaded purple). The SNPs for the whole combined sequences are boxed down the column in red in three different places, labeled “tag SNP” at the top. The first is at the fourth nucleotide (A for H1, A for H2, G for H3, A for H4). The second is at the 8th nucleotide over (T for H1, C for H2, T for H3, and C for H4). The third Tag SNP is located at the 15th nucleotide (C for H1, G for H2, C for H3, and C for H4). Arrows from the SNP diagram above point down and converge on a 3-nucleotide sequence from nucleotides 10-12. These are the sequences that match up with those described in the first chart: CGG (yellow), CAA (blue), TGA (green) and CGG (purple). Below, the 3 tagged columns of SNPs converge to (c), which is labeled left “tag SNPs.” The SNPs are then listed for the haplotypes: (1) ATC (yellow); (2) ACG (blue); (3) GTC (green); (4) ACC (purple).
